Class CircleSector

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Core.Shapes
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a sector (pie slice) of a circle, defined by a center, radius, rotation, and sector angle.

Remarks

The CircleSector class provides methods to generate polygons, points, and segments representing the sector. The arc of the sector can be approximated with a configurable number of points.
